scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-dev-volumes.mjs && docker compose up -d --build mysql minio mailpit && docker compose up -d --build api && docker compose up -d --build portal refresh && docker compose logs -f
scripts.dev:init-volumes: docker volume create cms_mysql_data && docker volume create cms_minio_data
scripts.local-prod:init-volumes: docker volume create refresh-local-prod_mysql_localprod_data && docker volume create refresh-local-prod_minio_localprod_data
scripts.local-prod:build: node scripts/guard-deployment-flow.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local-prod.yml build
scripts.local-prod:up: node scripts/guard-deployment-flow.mjs && node scripts/ensure-local-prod-volumes.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local-prod.yml up --build
scripts.docker:dev:deploy-migrations: docker exec abbatech-api npm run prisma:migrate -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:dev:generate: docker exec abbatech-api npm run prisma:generate -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:dev:status: docker exec abbatech-api npm run prisma:status -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:dev:seed: docker exec abbatech-api npm run prisma:seed -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:local-prod:up: node scripts/guard-deployment-flow.mjs && node scripts/ensure-local-prod-volumes.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local-prod.yml up -d --build
scripts.docker:local-prod:build: node scripts/guard-deployment-flow.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local-prod.yml build
scripts.docker:local-prod:migrate: docker exec abbatech-api-localprod npm run prisma:migrate -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:local-prod:generate: docker exec abbatech-api-localprod npm run prisma:generate -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:local-prod:status: docker exec abbatech-api-localprod npm run prisma:status -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:local-prod:seed: docker exec abbatech-api-localprod npm run prisma:seed -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.production.dokploy -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T api npm run prisma:migrate -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:prod:generate: docker compose --env-file .env.production.dokploy -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T api npm run prisma:generate -w @abbatech/api
scripts.docker:prod:status: docker compose --env-file .env.production.dokploy -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T api npm run prisma:status -w @abbatech/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @abbatech/api && npm run build -w @abbatech/portal && npm run build -w @abbatech/refresh
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @abbatech/api && npm run typecheck -w @abbatech/portal && npm run typecheck -w @abbatech/refresh
scripts.check:deploy-flow: node scripts/guard-deployment-flow.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check: node scripts/guard-deployment-flow.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
